overview: Owner Registration lets a client create a pet owner through POST /api/owners. The Owner entity persists first/last name, address, city and telephone; the request is validated and stored in the owners table. The current implementation performs no SMS verification step.
business_rules: Telephone is required and validated for length before an owner is saved.
Owner registration is exposed as POST /api/owners and returns the created owner.
First name, last name, address and city are mandatory fields on the Owner entity.
